subject: Scheduling: Greenridge security review for POC
messages:
From: Elena Vasquez <elena.v@greenridge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Todd Miller <todd.miller@greenridge.com>, procurement@greenridge.com
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Greenridge POC — security review request

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the product overview yesterday. As we discussed, the security team wants to run a short technical review focused on data flows, retention, and key management before we can move forward with the POC. Would your security/compliance team be available next week for a 60-minute session? We expect to include:
- Greenridge security (Elena + Todd)
- Procurement (for contractual questions)
- Greenridge platform engineers (will bring a data-flow diagram)

Ideal window: Tue–Thu, 3/13–3/15, mornings PT. If you need different days we can be flexible. Attached is our initial questionnaire (Greenridge_Security_Request.pdf).

Please advise who from Redwood should join.

Thanks,
Elena Vasquez
Head of Security Operations | Greenridge Energy

Attachment: Greenridge_Security_Request.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Vasquez <elena.v@greenridge.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@greenridge.com
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenridge POC — security review request

Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear windows. I’ll loop in our security lead and SE.

Quick notes:
- Diego (SE) will run a short demo of the proposed integration surface so your engineers can validate data flow.
- Monica (security/compliance) will cover SOC2, encryption, and our request/response logging.

Diego and Monica — can you please confirm available 60-minute blocks Tue–Thu morning PT next week? I’ll consolidate and send a calendar invite.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (555) 412-9981

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Elena Vasquez <elena.v@greenridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenridge POC — security review request

Sean / Elena — available windows from my side (all PT):
- Tue 2028-03-13: 09:00–10:30 (best for a 60-min slot at 09:00)
- Wed 2028-03-14: 08:30–11:00
- Thu 2028-03-15: 10:00–12:00

I’ll prepare a 15-minute demo + 30–40 minute Q&A targeted at the Greenridge data-flow doc. A couple of prep asks for your engineers (Elena / Todd):
- Share the deployment diagram (network boundaries, VPCs, proxies) at least 48 hours before the call.
- Which data elements are in-scope (PII, telemetry, aggregated metrics)?

I’ve attached our internal checklist which maps to the questionnaire you sent — should speed the review: redwood-sec-checklist.xlsx

Diego
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-sec-checklist.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Vasquez <elena.v@greenridge.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 07:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenridge POC — security review request

Hi all — Monica from Redwood security. A few items I want to confirm ahead of the session:
- Scope: confirm whether the review covers only POC (sandbox) or also production expectations — we need this for logging/retention commitments.
- Evidence: we’ll bring our SOC2 summary and KMS overview (link below). Please confirm whether Greenridge needs redacted logs or an architecture deep-dive.
- Attendees: please include your platform engineer(s) and procurement for any policy/retention dialogue.

If the window Tue 3/13 09:00 PT works (Diego suggested), I’ll reserve 60 minutes. Provisional agenda: 1) quick intros + scope (5m) 2) Diego demo (15m) 3) data-flow review (20m) 4) security controls + Q&A (20m).

Links: SOC2 summary — https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-redwood-soc2-summary

Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
